text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a large gain felt rewarding, but a big gain alone does not mean I should sell; I should consider its role in my overall portfolio.","I sold Stock B and Stock D for gains and Stock E for a tiny gain. I should not let the pleasure of locking in gains or the pain of losses replace a broader investment decision.","My account rose and fell while I mostly held, and recent price changes do not predict what comes next; I should avoid frequent trading in response to short-term moves."]}
